title: Variable count bound from index bounds
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over natural-number variables, and let $N$ be a natural number. If every variable index occurring in every clause of $\varphi$ is less than $N$, then the variable count of $\varphi$ is at most $N$.
hypotheses_covered: A CNF formula over natural-number variables
Every literal in every clause of $\varphi$ has variable index less than $N$
